about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/facts (SEMTOOLS SEM0, wf10 lane SM, 2026-11-14): edits of the fact-table builder, its codec and its reference read that the acceptance property must notice. Each mutant names the rule it breaks and the test that kills it, as SUITE:NAME in the shared ledger format.

mutants.name: sem0-qualified-dropped
mutants.origin: wf10 SM SEM0 (plan: qualified uses dropped)
mutants.rule: A name qualified by an imported package (lib.X) is a site of the package's member X, though the checker's Uses holds only the qualifier.

mutants.name: sem0-ops-in-map-order
mutants.origin: wf10 SM SEM0 (plan: rows in map order)
mutants.rule: The tables are in file order, never in map order: equal programs give equal bytes (the operation edges come from maps and are sorted by handle).

mutants.name: sem0-write-as-read
mutants.origin: wf10 SM SEM0 (plan: Write recorded as Read)
mutants.rule: The place an assignment writes is a Write site: its root and the field it selects.

mutants.name: sem0-field-key-dropped
mutants.origin: wf10 SM SEM0 (plan: a field key of a record literal dropped)
mutants.rule: A field key of a record literal or record pattern is a site of the field, though the checker's Uses does not hold it.

mutants.name: sem0-pattern-binding-dropped
mutants.origin: wf10 SM SEM0 (plan: a pattern binding dropped)
mutants.to:
if o != nil && b.info.Patterns[x] == nil {
		k = Def
mutants.rule: A name a pattern binds (case x, Some{Value: v}, as c) is the Def site of its local.

mutants.name: sem0-handle-by-package-name
mutants.origin: wf10 SM SEM0 (plan: a cross-package row keyed by pointer; a row holds a handle string, so the nearest writable edit keys it by the package's name, which two packages share)
mutants.rule: A row that names a symbol of another package names it by the package's path: two packages named lib are two symbols' owners.

mutants.name: sem0-read-scans-all
mutants.origin: wf10 SM SEM0 (plan: the read scans all rows)
mutants.rule: A references read visits the symbol's rows plus a logarithm of each table's handle index (plan 2.9 budget 1).

mutants.name: sem0-inst-dropped
mutants.rule: The callee of a call that instantiates a generic function carries Inst.

mutants.name: sem0-handled-as-match
mutants.rule: A failure a catch arm names is a Handles site, not a pattern.

mutants.name: sem0-member-law-walked-twice
mutants.origin: wf10 SM SEM0 (plan: rows appended equal identifiers resolved, no second pass)
mutants.from: syntax.Inspect(x, func(n syntax.Node) bool { return n == x || b.visit(n) })
mutants.rule: The build visits each node once: the walk of a member law under its own handle does not count the law twice.

mutants.name: sem0-local-handle-not-unique
mutants.rule: A local has a handle only when its declaration binds its name once: one handle names one symbol.

mutants.name: sem0-codec-drops-flag
mutants.rule: An encoded table decodes to the table it was written from.

mutants.name: q16-exit-not-decoded
mutants.rule: A machine's exit actions survive the table's encoding (gallery's studio has one).
